name: dream-home-visualizer
description: Standalone Windows architectural visualizer with full-plan interior editing, fixed synchronized viewport, independently scrolling control rail, protected renderer spacing, image-derived boundary learning, PBR interiors and locked first-person controls
author: Upenyu Hlangabeza

scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir dist-electron --watch --sourcemap
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir dist-electron --sourcemap && node scripts/verify-electron-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: npm run test:ui-stability && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
